name: Tattooing Your Body
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers to refrain from marking their bodies with cuts or tattoos, as seen in Leviticus 19:28 and Deuteronomy 14:1, where God commands His people not to make any cuts or print marks on themselves for the dead. This prohibition reflects a call to honor God with our bodies and avoid practices tied to pagan mourning rituals. Instead, Christians are encouraged to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness (Matthew 6:33), trusting that their identity and worth come from Him. Ultimately, true marking belongs to Christ alone, who bears the name 'KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS' upon His own body (Revelation 19:16).
